blocks.text: Subnetting divides a network into smaller parts. Each part is called a subnet (as shown in Figure 1.15). It reduces network traffic. Subnetting improves performance. It increases security. Large networks use subnetting for management.

blocks.alt: The network 192.168.1.0/24 at the top splits by dashed lines into Subnet 1 (192.168.1.0/25), holding a desktop computer, a network device and a laptop, and Subnet 2 (192.168.1.128/25), holding a mobile phone and a printer.
